page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6e-c12g1.24xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for high-performance computing, machine learning, and deep learning workloads. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The server is equipped with 736.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.67 GB of RAM per core. For acceleration, it integrates eight NVIDIA Volta V100 GPUs, delivering a combined 256 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM.

Performance benchmarks reflect the specialized nature of this hardware configuration. In stress-ng testing, the single-core CPU performance is relatively weak, placing in the bottom 25% with a score of 1104.49, which is typical for older-generation Intel Xeon processors with lower base clock speeds. However, the multi-core CPU performance is highly robust, scoring 70674.73 and placing in the top 25% due to the massive parallel processing capability of its 96 dedicated physical cores. The instance does not include any local NVMe storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage, supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this instance represents a high-density resource allocation suited for enterprise-scale parallel computing. The inclusion of eight enterprise-grade GPUs and a large memory footprint makes it a capital-intensive resource, but highly efficient for workloads that can fully saturate its parallel processing capabilities. It is best suited for deep learning training, large-scale AI inference, molecular modeling, seismic analysis, and complex scientific simulations.
